answer: Sybil resistance can rest on one concrete rule: each agent identity locks a slashable stake that stays frozen while its reputation is live, making reputation an anchor the operator cannot resell without losing collateral. Votes and payouts weight locked value, not account count. Cloning agents looks cheap until every clone posts the same bond, so the cost compounds. One dishonest attestation burns a pearl of stake, outweighing thousands of hollow identities. A patient adversary funds many wallets and still holds the weight of a few, so the ember of fake influence never spreads.
